specification.title: Financial institution leadership
specification.outcome: Integrate business strategy, capital, liquidity, risk and operating accountability.

genre: Professional institutional leadership with complete original economic/financial models and inspectable decision artifacts; no fabricated real leadership.
requirements: Two complete original financial-institution leadership cases integrating business model, capital allocation, liquidity/risk appetite, controls, compensation and regulatory relations. Reconciled balance sheet/loss/liquidity and decision rights, internal versus official requirements distinguished. Fresh dated official primary sources for changing actual regulatory claims. Full decision/committee/control/escalation artifacts, boundary and counterfactual math, eight full answers. Distinct from C01channel selection and C04hedge hiring case.

Read necessary accepted economic/financial/research/teaching prerequisites and canonical coverage. Use bounded inspected primary sources for unresolved claims; original models and cases. Current laws/regulations or institutional policies require fresh official dated jurisdiction-aware retrieval; do not use broad professional advice as legal authority. Reuse stable verified source scopes with original inspector attribution. No fictional evidence represented as real responsibility.
